_comment: The rules rule-triggers.js prints, each once a session per agent, at the trigger its script names.

two-registers.text: **Two readers, two registers.** The founder reads `title`, `description`, `note`, `fit.<project>.take` and a collection's `name`, `description` and `deployFor`: plain English a non-designer follows, any design term glossed in a few words. `image_recipe`, `vocabulary`, `composition` and a collection's `imageStyle`, `vocabulary` and `risk` feed an AI and stay technical (design-vault#2 Q6).

note-intent.text: **A `note` carries the founder's intent, not the picture's contents.** Draft it from his own words about why he saved the reference — the ten-site note in lucmoseley/mantahostels#3037, the background-art principles in lucmoseley/mantahostels#3057 — and lead with what he was after: a feel, a behaviour, one part. Where no words of his exist, name the overall feel, hedge at most one likely part, and say no note from him was found; he saved many references "for specific small parts of them, or their vague overall 'vibe'".

plugin-release.text: **A session that lands a commit touching `plugin/` releases it before it ends**, by README §Releasing a plugin change. `release-check.js` prints the unreleased count at session start; it reports and never refuses (#58).
